title: Run historical Paper confirmation only for ETH Up or Down 5m 22 Child ROI
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Я хочу, чтобы в первую очередь пересчиталась стратегия ETH Up or Down 5m 22 Child ROI. Как это сделать?
Меня даже устроит, если (помимо новых ставок, у них всегда приоритет) история будет пересчитываться только по этой стратегии

scope.goal: Re-enable the existing historical Paper verifier and restrict its candidate selection to ETH Up or Down 5m 22 Child ROI, preserving the existing independent new-stake path and current load control.
inScope: Only strategy b7c50005-0000-4000-8195-000000000022 (eth_up_down_5m_22_child_roi) in the historical confirmation candidate query, across both existing Recent and Archive lanes and all creation dates.
Register the existing PaperOutcomeConfirmationWorker in PolyCopyTrader.Service; retain its current scheduling, load pauses, batch size, retry and final-outcome correction logic.
Focused tests for target-only candidate selection and service registration, service build, and minimal README/task-status update.
outOfScope: No background history selection for another strategy and no priority sorting across strategies.
No change to worker Idle admission, scheduling, batching, overload response, confirmation rules, financial formulas, new-stake final settlement, trading signals, sizing, execution or Live orders.
No production deployment, service restart, direct production database writes, schema/index migration or backup.
scope.periodOrFilter: All unconfirmed Paper orders of strategy_id=b7c50005-0000-4000-8195-000000000022, with no creation-date cutoff. Read-only production preview at 2026-09-23 19:40 UTC: 2697 closed orders, 198 confirmed, 2499 unconfirmed; the background worker is currently unregistered.
